_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: SKL-<recordNo>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

name.description: Name of the skill; used as its display value in other collections

skillCategoryName.description: Display value of skillCategoryId, copied from u_mes_mast_skillCategory.name

minimumLevelRequired.description: Lowest skill level allowed to work unsupervised

trainingControlledDocumentId.description: Reference to u_mes_syst_controlledDocument._id: training controlled document

trainingControlledDocumentName.description: Display value of trainingControlledDocumentId, copied from u_mes_syst_controlledDocument.title

isSafetyCritical.description: True when the record is safety critical

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
